channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Rare all-white deer spotted wandering through the New Forest
item.description: A rare white fallow deer has been spotted traversing the New Forest landscape.

item.title: Exploring Southampton's Donkey Common and the legend behind the name
item.description: The Echo is taking a diversion off the main Southampton greenspace to visit one of the more bizarrely-named - Donkey Common.

item.title: PCC to seek approval for £15 increase to policing element of council tax
item.description: The Police and Crime Commissioner (PCC) is set to seek approval for a £15 increase in the policing element of council tax for households across Hampshire and the Isle of Wight.

item.title: City schools face ‘significant’ £1.35m funding shortfall
item.description: Schools across Southampton are facing the “deeply concerning situation” of receiving funding below the level set by the government’s own rules.

item.title: West End shop announces closure, but is 'actively exploring' other space
item.description: Mountbatten's West End charity shop has announced its permanent closure, but says there is a possibility of opening another 'small retail space'.

item.title: Concorde Club founder with stories behind 70 years of success
item.description: The Concorde Club has been the beating heart of Eastleigh and Southampton’s social scene for nearly 70 years and the man behind it is to take centre stage

item.title: Council to review switching off street lights at night amid fears over crime
item.description: A review of a council’s policy to turn off street lights for several hours of the night in parts of Southampton will be conducted following concerns about women’s safety and theft.

item.title: Plans for 192 homes on greenfield land given go ahead
item.description: Plans for 190 homes on greenfield land in Hedge End have been approved, despite objections from residents.

item.title: Fury over traffic lights at junction as change is called a 'sledgehammer'
item.description: Southampton City Councillor Jeremy Moulton has sparked intense reaction after his Facebook call for action over the city's traffic lights.

item.title: Evri driver sacked after five parcels delivered to wrong addresses in two weeks
item.description: A woman said she was pushed to the verge of tears after five parcels failed to arrive at her home over a fortnight.
